slices.focus: Roof and bathroom repairs finally finished; home feels settled
slices.summary: After months of delays, the roof and bathroom work is finally finished. Lucia and Daniel spend a weekend hauling boxes back upstairs and reclaiming their home from repair staging. The debt from the expanded project remains but is no longer growing — the ceiling on the problem changes how it feels. The conversation explores how chronic home disruption amplified every other stress, and how having a settled home base again (fresh towels, no tarps, no tools) improves her morning mood, patience, and baseline tension. She decides to keep next weekend light (one reset task, one comfort thing) rather than overcorrecting into perfection, and plans a low-stakes coffee visit to prove the place is home again.
